definitions.explanation: The collective views and attitudes of the general public on a particular issue.

examples.japanese: {世論|せろん}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: To conduct a public opinion poll.

examples.japanese: {世論|せろん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
{世論|せろん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{味方|みかた}→味方：03743_mikata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦つける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: To win public opinion to one's side.

examples.japanese: ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{世論|せろん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えている→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: Television reporting has a large influence on public opinion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{世論|せろん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{分|わ}かれており→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧、⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{慎重|しんちょう}に→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}する→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Public opinion on the new law is deeply divided between support and opposition, and the government needs to respond carefully.

notes:
{世論|せろん} means public opinion — the general views held by the population on social or political issues. The kanji break down as {世|せ} (world/society) + ⟦{論|ろん}→〜論：04017_ron⟧ (opinion/discourse).

PRONUNCIATION:
Both せろん and よろん are accepted readings. Historically, よろん referred to ⟦{輿論|よろん}→世論：16145_yoron⟧ (informed public opinion), while せろん was used for {世論|せろん} (popular sentiment), but this distinction has largely been lost in modern usage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世論|せろん}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: public opinion poll/survey
- {世論|せろん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{喚起|かんき}→喚起：28817_kanki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to arouse public opinion
- {世論|せろん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧: public support
- {世論|せろん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まる→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧: public opinion grows stronger
- {世論|せろん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かす→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧: to sway public opinion

USAGE:
Frequently used in news, politics, and social discussions. {世論|せろん}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧ (opinion polls) are regularly conducted and reported by media.
